cover_prompt: Full-color illustration, warm cozy cottagecore aesthetic, premium coloring book cover artwork. A charming kawaii cat wearing a hand-knit sweater sits in a plush armchair surrounded by colorful yarn balls and crochet projects. The cozy craft room has wooden shelves lined with baskets of rainbow yarn skeins, knitting needles in a ceramic holder, a finished amigurumi bunny sitting on the shelf, and a crochet blanket draped over the chair arm. A wicker basket overflows with pastel yarn balls at the cat's feet, a half-finished granny square blanket sits on the ottoman, crochet hooks of different sizes rest on a side table next to a steaming cup of tea. Warm golden and soft pink tones throughout, soft afternoon light streaming through a curtained window showing a cottage garden with climbing roses. Rich saturated colors, whimsical cute style with large expressive eyes, inviting and relaxing crafting atmosphere. NO text in the image.
